title: Line sketch: Smoky Industrial Nightscape
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A dramatic monochrome scene depicts a hillside industrial complex with pagoda-style buildings belching thick black smoke into the cloudy night sky. A bright full moon illuminates the ominous clouds above the dark silhouettes of factories and fences (derived from painting #882).
